Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, only when this answer is a replay of the stored response of an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

packingOption.description: `CASE_PACKED` cartons hold one item at the case GTIN's units per pack; `INDIVIDUAL` cartons are packed by the seller as it sees fit.
packingOption.title: PackingOption

placementOption.description: `SELLER_SPLIT` (the default) sends everything to the destination the seller picked; `NETWORK_SPLIT` destinations an ACTIVE `INBOUND_CROSS_DOCK` and records a redistribution of the plan's eaches across the region's fulfilment centres (ADR 0015). The redistribution is a recorded fact: nothing downstream executes it.
placementOption.title: PlacementOption

items.description: One line of an inbound plan, in eaches.

gtin.description: 14 digits with a GS1 mod-10 check digit.

unitVolumeDm3.description: The seller-declared volume of one each, in cubic decimetres (ADR 0015). Omitted or 0 = undeclared: the capacity gate then records itself unenforced and never blocks the plan.

items.title: PlanLine

redistribution.description: The recorded capacity-split-v1 redistribution; present only for NETWORK_SPLIT (ADR 0015).

items.description: One (node, line) share of a NETWORK_SPLIT plan's recorded redistribution (capacity-split-v1, ADR 0015).

lineNo.description: The line's 1-based position in the plan.

items.title: RedistributionLine

placementFeeBasis.description: The recorded fee-basis fact; present only for NETWORK_SPLIT (ADR 0015).

allOf.description: The recorded placement fee basis of a NETWORK_SPLIT plan (ADR 0015) - a fact for a future vendor-settlement context, never a charge.

dm3.description: The plan's total declared volume; 0 when any line's unit volume is undeclared.

nodeIds.description: The redistribution's recipients, unique and sorted.

allOf.title: PlacementFeeBasis

capacityEnforced.description: Whether the monthly capacity gate was actually applied - both the node's declared monthly volume and every line's unit volume known (ADR 0015). false never blocks the plan; the unenforced fact is recorded.

409.description: The write conflicts with the state of a resource. Problem types: `seller-exists`, `seller-suspended` (`ErrSellerSuspended`), `node-cannot-receive` (`ErrNodeCannotReceive`), `sscc-not-unique` (`ErrSsccNotUnique`), `shipment-not-labelled` (`ErrShipmentNotLabelled`), `illegal-transition` and `concurrent-update` (optimistic-concurrency conflict; re-read and retry), and `idempotency-key-reused` (the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different method, path or body; a client bug, do not retry).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `sscc-not-unique`.

500.description: An unexpected failure (`internal-error`); the `detail` never carries the internal message. A 5xx is never stored by the idempotency middleware, so the same `Idempotency-Key` retries the real work.
